Application Deadlines
Instructions for Interpreting Deadline Fields for Academic Programs
When reviewing program deadlines, please refer to the following guidelines:
Standard Deadline is Null
If the Standard Deadline field is null, it means the program does not have that entry term active. In other words, the program is not admitting students for that term.
International Deadline is Null
If the International Deadline field is null, it typically indicates one of the following:
The program is fully online, and international deadlines do not apply.
The program follows a Standard Deadline that is earlier than the typical international deadline, so no separate international deadline is listed.
Summer Term Restrictions
International students are generally not eligible to begin studies in the Summer term, with the exception of a limited number of approved programs.
For any questions or clarification, please contact the admissions office at gsadmissions@uky.edu.
